newsitem.title: CHINA: China province shuts illegal futures and stock firm.
newsitem.headline: China province shuts illegal futures and stock firm.

text.p: Authorities in China's southern Guangxi region have closed a firm found illegally trading financial futures and stocks, the Financial News said on Wednesday.

Central bank officials teamed up with officials of the regional Securities Regulatory Commission and police in the regional capital Nanning to close the Nanning Gaoteli Information Consultancy Co, the newspaper said.
It was the second firm engaging in illegal futures and stock trading to be closed within two weeks, it added.
Recently, stock trading firms and non-financial institutions had been set up in the region without central bank approval, disrupting financial order, the newspaper said.
The local branch of the central bank had issued warnings to those firms and ordered them to close immediately, the newspaper said.
The notice warned investors to use legal firms to avoid losses, it said.
